name: lossless-compaction
description: Lossless context compaction for Claude Code: old tool output moves to local files and comes back unchanged by id, or by what it is about with a Jev key.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where find asks Jev: auto, typesafe or cloudflare. auto asks Cloudflare when an account id is entered, else TypeSafe. Set to one, a key in the environment is used; with no key at all, nothing is sent. Default auto. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The key for Jev, used by find alone; set it in your user settings. Unset, a key in the environment is used once provider is typesafe or cloudflare or an account id is entered; with none, nothing is sent. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account id
cloudflareAccountId.description: 32 hexadecimal characters, for Jev on Cloudflare Workers AI. With provider on auto, entering one sends the key to Cloudflare; leave it empty for TypeSafe. Unset by default. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: The Jev model the typesafe provider asks for; on Cloudflare the model is always typesafe/jev. Default jev-latest. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

storeDir.title: Where moved-out results are kept
storeDir.description: Its own absolute directory, made mode 700, in your user settings (a repository's stops the plugin). Unset, lossless-compaction, or an older jev-lossless-compaction, under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

targetPercent.title: Target size
targetPercent.description: How far a compaction goes, in percent of where Claude Code compacts on its own (else the model's window): higher can leave more in place. From 1 to 99, else the nearest end. Default 1. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

keepTokens.title: Newest results to leave alone, in tokens
keepTokens.description: Tokens of the newest tool results left in place, the newest always; long inputs and messages get as many. A /compact without instructions reaches into them. From 0 to 1,000,000, else the nearest end. Default 20,000. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

minChars.title: Smallest result to move out one by one
minChars.description: Results, input values and messages shorter than this, in characters, are not moved out one by one. From 0 to 10,000,000, else the nearest end. Default 2,000. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.

maxAfterPercent.title: Largest size to go on with
maxAfterPercent.description: Over this percent of where Claude Code compacts (else the model's window) after moving out, old messages are kept in parts; /compact with instructions summarizes. From 1 to 100, else the nearest end. Default 75. See "Settings" in docs/usage.md.
